headline: [Huge Debut!] Anthropic Shares Open [34% Higher] on Nasdaq
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Anthropic Shares Open 34% Higher on Nasdaq

Anthropic, the company behind the AI assistant Claude, started trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday, November 19, under the ticker "ANT". Its shares opened at $111.50, about 34% above the IPO price of $83, putting the company's value above $2 trillion at the open.

🔹 The IPO raised about $81.3 billion, the biggest stock market listing on record, ahead of SpaceX's $75 billion in June.
🔹 CEO Dario Amodei and president Daniela Amodei rang the Nasdaq opening bell.
🔹 The IPO price of $83 was set above the planned range of $70 to $78 per share.
